identification_notes.facial_recognition: Face match confirmed at 3 different timestamps - entering at 21:15, at window at 21:12-21:15, and exiting at 22:00-22:01

identification_notes.gait_analysis: Distinctive walk pattern (slight side-to-side) matches accused's gait

cctv_analysis_report.conclusion: CCTV footage conclusively establishes the following: (1) Accused Sanjay Sharma approached victim's house at 21:12 via back lane; (2) Entered through back window at 21:15; (3) Was inside for approximately 45 minutes; (4) Between 21:45-21:58 the crime occurred (scream heard by neighbour at 21:45); (5) Exited at 21:58-22:00 carrying cloth-wrapped object (murder weapon); (6) Escaped in vehicle owned by his cousin. The footage corroborates the entire timeline established through other evidence.
cctv_analysis_report.certification: I hereby certify that the above CCTV analysis is true and correct based on the footage examined. All timestamps verified and consistent.
